universe: Fixed convenience sample of the four companies in the 25/26 Nov large-cap comparison (two banks, two IT). No market-wide or random sample.
source_cutoff: Public information dated no later than 2026-11-27 IST; not an exhaustive event scan.
primary_target: First published reported quarterly PAT matching each scope, including exceptional items; no substitution of adjusted PAT or EPS.

baseline_definitions.raw_yoy_trend: FY26 Q3 PAT * FY27 Q2 PAT / FY26 Q2 PAT
baseline_definitions.adjusted_yoy_trend: Apply documented prior-period exceptional expense adjustments only to prior Q3 and Q2, then repeat raw formula. Use actual identified tax impact where disclosed (INFY), otherwise prior effective tax rate as a mechanical proxy. This is an evidence-informed simple baseline, not pure price-only quant.

driver_definition: Assisted analyst-chosen drivers, accounting calculator, no assumed new one-off charges. Forecast actual reported PAT, not normalized earnings. Same-period annual growth is not a multi-year expected return.
primary_metric: Paired mean absolute forecast error divided by absolute frozen prior-year Q3 PAT, equal issuer weight. Also report signed/absolute errors, direction accuracy and pair wins/ties against each baseline. Do not cherry-pick the easiest baseline or drop missing cases.
evaluation: First public matching original result after target period ends; preserve first-release source/date, check scope, units, restatement separately, leave missing null. Scoring code checks metadata shape, not authenticity. Report partial coverage as partial, no promotion or p-value on four firms. Later corrections must be a separate dated record; never edit forecast.
